activity_summary: At midday the jaw was healed and you ate a crust. The loaf was still a penny and a full thumb short of the notch. You said you are in the afternoon play, and you did not name a part. The red bundle stays tied. You have no story yet to bring home. Mistress Ansell still does not go to a playhouse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate the end piece, kept the bundle shut, and promised no play at the table.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Tested the jaw, restated the threepence and the one candle, and did not ask the title.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Returned the crust to the board and measured the loaf again.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Moved from the book to the brick.
